# SourcingLens

> AI-powered import cost tools for US importers. Calculate true landed costs, look up HS codes, and identify IEEPA tariff refund eligibility — in minutes, not days.

SourcingLens (sourcinglens.com) helps US importers make faster, more accurate sourcing decisions. The site provides two core tools: a landed cost calculator that compares sourcing countries side-by-side using live 2026 tariff rates, and an IEEPA Tariff Refund Analyzer that identifies which past shipments may qualify for a duty refund under the IEEPA tariff rollback.

## Tools

- [Landed Cost Calculator](https://sourcinglens.com/): Free. Enter a product description, country of origin, and unit cost — get a multi-country landed cost comparison (China, Vietnam, Mexico, India, Bangladesh) with tariff, freight, and compliance cost breakdowns. Powered by Claude AI for HS code inference.

- [IEEPA Tariff Refund Analyzer](https://sourcinglens.com/ieepa-refund): Upload CBP Form 7501 PDFs or ACE export CSVs. The tool parses entry dates, duty amounts, and liquidation status to flag eligible entries and estimate refund amounts including 6% interest. Free preview; $79 for full Refund Report with CAPE CSV and broker handoff PDF.

## IEEPA Refund Guides

- [IEEPA Tariff Refund 2026: Complete Guide](https://sourcinglens.com/blog/ieepa-tariff-refund-guide-2026): Which tariff types are refundable, eligibility requirements, Phase 1 vs Phase 2 windows, and the end-to-end claim process.

- [How to File a CAPE Declaration: Step-by-Step](https://sourcinglens.com/blog/cape-declaration-step-by-step): Six concrete steps to file a CAPE declaration in ACE — entry number format, CSV structure, portal navigation, and common rejection reasons.

- [How Much IEEPA Refund Am I Owed?](https://sourcinglens.com/blog/how-much-ieepa-refund-am-i-owed): Refund formula with worked examples for China electronics, Vietnam apparel, and Mexico industrial goods. Includes interest calculation and quick-estimate table by country.

## Landed Cost & Tariff Guides

- [China Tariff Calculator 2026](https://sourcinglens.com/blog/china-tariff-calculator-2026): How to calculate true landed cost from China after Section 301 duties, IEEPA tariffs, and de minimis elimination.

- [Vietnam vs China Landed Cost 2026](https://sourcinglens.com/blog/vietnam-vs-china-landed-cost-2026): Side-by-side landed cost comparison — when the 20+ point tariff gap makes Vietnam cheaper despite higher FOB prices.

- [How to Find Your HS Code](https://sourcinglens.com/blog/how-to-find-hs-code): USITC lookup method, misclassification traps, and when to request a CBP binding ruling.

## Key Facts

- Tariff data current as of 2026
- IEEPA tariff window: entries dated 2025-02-04 through 2026-02-24
- IEEPA Phase 1: unliquidated entries, or liquidated within 80 days of CAPE filing
- IEEPA Phase 2: liquidated entries more than 80 days ago (requires protest filing)
- Interest on IEEPA refunds accrues at 6% annually from entry date
- Not legal or customs brokerage advice; outputs are for planning purposes only
- Contact: enquiries.talkace@gmail.com
